learning_order:
**1-10:** Buy everything (Classic advice: train all up to 20). Stealth, Pick Pocket, Gouge, Evasion, Sinister Strike/Eviscerate ranks. Backstab only if you use a dagger.
Do not open every mob from Stealth at low level; it slows you down (Warcraft Tavern).
**10:** Dual Wield first (huge damage boost), Slice and Dice, Sprint. Sap is optional (group CC).
**12-20:** Kick, Parry, Sinister Strike 3, Eviscerate 3. Garrote/Ambush/Backstab only for dagger or Subtlety builds. Expose Armor is optional (strong on long fights in Forever).
Skip Feint (group threat), Gouge ranks 2+ and Kick ranks 2+ (only add damage).
**20-30:** Vanish (22), Cheap Shot (26), Kidney Shot (30), Sinister Strike/Eviscerate ranks. Poisons class quest at 20.
Rupture: Subtlety bleed builds buy it, others can skip. Skip Distract, Detect Traps, Disarm Trap.
Pick Lock (16) is optional: lockboxes and some quest chests.
**30-40:** Keep Sinister Strike, Eviscerate and your spec's builder/opener current. Stealth ranks and Sprint 2 are nice but optional. Save for the 40 mount.
**40-60:** Mutilate ranks if you took the talent. Slice and Dice 2 (42), Kidney Shot 2 (50). Skip Safe Fall, Feint ranks, Sap ranks unless grouping.
Spec focus: Combat = Sinister Strike, Slice and Dice, Eviscerate; Assassination = Mutilate, Ambush, Slice and Dice; Subtlety = Ambush/Garrote/Rupture (+ Hemorrhage talent).
Money: pick pocket humanoids (opener macro), Skinning + Leatherworking; use buff food for the XP bonus.
disagreements: Slice and Dice: Warcraft Tavern Classic says not worth using until 42; Method (Forever) calls it the main finisher and high priority, Warcraft Tavern Forever keeps it up in every spec.
Backstab: Warcraft Tavern Classic says you can hardly use it solo (mobs face you); Method (Forever) says it beats Sinister Strike with daggers and is easier in groups.
Garrote: Warcraft Tavern Classic sword build trains every rank; its dagger build skips it. In Forever it is core for Subtlety bleed builds only.
forever_differences: Sap no longer breaks Stealth (Blizzard deep dive).
Expose Armor reduction raised to about 5 Sunder Armors and no longer blocks Sunder (deep dive) - more useful on long fights.
Feint threat reduction doubled; Distract also lowers enemy stealth detection (deep dive).
Poisons have more charges, can crit and stack with sharpening stones/Windfury (deep dive, Warcraft Tavern Forever).
Mutilate is a new 21-point Assassination talent with trainer ranks at 40/50/60 (deep dive).
New baseline Energy builder Shank; rogues can use one-handed axes (Warcraft Tavern Forever, deep dive).
Weapon specializations removed; Combat's Hack and Slash works with any weapon (deep dive).
open_questions: Blind and poisons are not in the Forever trainer list; guides still mention them (likely quest/vendor learned).
No source covers what Stealth ranks 2-4 or Vanish rank 2 change in Forever.
